watched #GulaboSitabo : You need patience and passion to watch this movie!!!! to start with the Lucknowi slang makes it very hard for large of audience to connect with whats happening on screen and the slooow naration tests the patience!!!!

if you can overcome that major hurdle then you are in for an excellent ride given by the combo of AB vs AK!!! Story wise its Landlord Vs Tenant which is a desi adoption of Tom vs Jerry…..with few genuine roasts _/\_

on screen the chars of Ayushman and Amitabh tried to overshadow each other but in actual AB and AK were supporting this plot as major pillars _/\_ and the best performances were a simple cake walk for them!!! Never seen AB in such a kammenaa avtar 😛
